text:
eng-release-lead: Quick sync — finalizing the internal release note + ops snippet for tomorrow's microblast. Core bits: autoscaler fix, batching perf tune, and a fallback pin for model-family X. Need: short blurb for staff, deploybot schedule, canary window, rollback criteria. @sam.pm @lisa.ops can you eyeball?

sam.pm: I can do the one-line blurb and audience split. Target: ENG + SRE + Sales Ops internal channels. Keep customer-facing note separate.

alice.k: Draft one-liner: "Deploy: autoscaler stability fix, batching throughput improvements, and model-family X pin fallback to v2.3.1 to avoid regressions. Expect brief canary (30m) then staged rollout." :rocket:

ryan.docs: Nice. For the internal RN, can we follow the 3-part microblast template: TL;DR, What Changed, Ops/How to Respond? I'll paste a stub below.

ryan.docs: ```TL;DR
- Autoscaler fix (prevents pod thrashing under spiky traffic)
- Default batching improved (latency 8-12% median)
- Model-family X pinned to v2.3.1 on fallback paths

What changed
- infra: autoscaler backoff tuning + health probes
- runtime: batching strategy tweak for short sequences
- models: fallback routing rule added to pin model-family X to v2.3.1 if higher-latency variants are detected

Ops / rollback
- Canary: staging 02:00-02:30 UTC, prod canary 03:00-03:30 UTC
- Rollback triggers: >5% error increase or >20% latency P95 regression for 10m
- Rollback action: `/deploy rollback release-2026-03-22-xx` and pin routing back to previous model tag
```

lisa.ops: Oncall ok with the windows. Two notes: 1) please include the exact deploybot commands (ops will run them), 2) add a contact list (oncall + release owner). I also want a short evacuation plan if canary spikes.

eng-release-lead: Good call. Deploybot commands below — please confirm syntax before I paste into the RN.

eng-release-lead: ```/deploy schedule release-2026-03-22 --canary staging:2026-03-22T02:00Z,prod:2026-03-22T03:00Z --notify eng-oncall,eng-sre --notes "Autoscaler & batching microblast"```

Deploy Bot: Scheduled release-2026-03-22 (canary staging 2026-03-22T02:00Z, prod 2026-03-22T03:00Z). Ping targets: eng-oncall, eng-sre. Status: queued.

alice.k: Microcopy tweak for internal header: "Microblast: Autoscaler & Batching improvements — brief canary; rollback plan included." I'll push that to the RN draft doc and tag @ryan.docs. :eyes:

sam.pm: Audience split: ENG & SRE get full Ops section, Sales Ops gets TL;DR + impact notes. I'll prepare the Sales Ops snippet.

lisa.ops: Evacuation plan (short): if canary triggers, abort rollout, run health-check script, scale down new tasks, and trigger rollback command within 10m. Add exact runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-evac>.

eng-release-lead: Perfect. Last asks: 1) add the pinned model mapping lines (we'll include a short YAML snippet), 2) confirm the RN will be posted to #eng-releases and emailed to staff list at T-30m.

alice.k: YAML snippet: ```model_pin:
  model-family-x: v2.3.1
  fallback-window: 5m```

ryan.docs: I'll finalize RN now and drop the share link when ready. Will also include the deploybot commands verbatim and the oncall roster. ETA 20m.

Deploy Bot: Reminder scheduled: release-2026-03-22 will send internal announce at 2026-03-22T02:30Z (post-canary) unless canceled.

sam.pm: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll prep the Sales Ops brief and confirm the staff email draft.

eng-release-lead: Thanks team — once ryan drops the doc link I'll pin it and we can set the deploybot announce. Standby 02:00 UTC for staging canary.
